content.content:
Per-session gate→(n, D) calibration for a dual-gated device.

Construct **once** per session from the live-calibrated values, then call
`density` / `displacement_field` / `n_D` per cell. Conventions match the
session ana notebooks (`calc_nD`) and the device card, all SI:

    n = (c_tg·V_tg + c_bg·V_bg) / e   + n_offset      [m^-2]
    D = (c_tg·V_tg − c_bg·V_bg) / (2·ε₀) + D_offset   [V/m]

Capacitances are per-area (F/m²), voltages in V, `n_offset` in m^-2,
`D_offset` in V/m. The capacitance ratio/scale and offsets are
per-session and established live — that's why they're inputs, not library
constants. (For the conventional ×10¹² cm^-2 display unit, scale n by
1e-16.)
--- Run
A loaded sweep run.
['col', 'col_at', 'col_indices', 'complete', 'interrupted', 'kind', 'metadata', 'recipe', 'rows', 'setpoints', 'swept_axis', 'tags']
['D_offset', 'density', 'displacement_field', 'from_thicknesses', 'n_D', 'n_offset']
(c_tg: 'float', c_bg: 'float', n_offset: 'float' = 0.0, D_offset: 'float' = 0.0) -> None

"""SdH spot checks, runs 6 (electron, n=+3.2e12) and 7 (hole, n=-1.2e12): raw MR,
onset (hera.analysis.sdh_onset), 1/B FFT, tones vs F_L. Sets the fan design."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import (open_run, summarize_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft,
                           luttinger_frequency, GateCalibration, SdhOnsetError)

HERE = Path("/home/hera/measurements/zack/20260822-vti-02")
cal_d = json.load(open(HERE / "hera_scratch" / "cal_run5.json"))
cal = GateCalibration(c_tg=cal_d["c_tg"], c_bg=cal_d["c_bg"],
                      n_offset=cal_d["n_offset"] * 1e16, D_offset=cal_d["D_offset"] * 1e9)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8))
out = {}
for k, rid in enumerate([6, 7]):
    run = open_run(HERE / "data" / str(rid))
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"RUN {rid}")
    print(summarize_run(run))
    mc = run.metadata["measurement_config"]
    gain = mc["sr0_gain"]  # unused: sr1 is the Rxx channel
    B = run.col("magnet_field")
    T = run.col("T_sample")
    vtg, vbg = run.col("k_2400_tg_curr"), run.col("k_2400_bg_curr")
    # Rxx from sr1 (gain 1, unity) / I_bias ; I_bias = sr1 amplitude / bias resistor
    # sr1 is BOTH the drive oscillator and the Rxx voltage channel (device card).
    sens = None
    inst = run.metadata.get("instruments", {})
    amp = inst.get("sr1", {}).get("snapshot", {}).get("parameters", {}).get("amplitude", {}).get("value")
    sen = inst.get("sr1", {}).get("snapshot", {}).get("parameters", {}).get("sensitivity", {}).get("value")
    tau = inst.get("sr1", {}).get("snapshot", {}).get("parameters", {}).get("time_constant", {}).get("value")
    slope = inst.get("sr1", {}).get("snapshot", {}).get("parameters", {}).get("filter_slope", {}).get("value")
    print(f"  sr1 amplitude={amp} sensitivity={sen} tau={tau} slope={slope}")
    I_bias = (amp / mc["bias_resistor"]) if amp else None
    sr1X = run.col("sr1_X")
    R = np.abs(sr1X) / I_bias if I_bias else np.abs(sr1X)
    print(f"  N={len(B)} pts; B {B.min():.3f}..{B.max():.3f} T; T {np.nanmin(T):.3f}..{np.nanmax(T):.3f} K")
    print(f"  I_bias = {I_bias*1e9:.3f} nA; R {R.min():.1f}..{R.max():.1f} Ohm")
    print(f"  gate curr TG {np.abs(vtg).max()*1e12:.0f} pA max, BG {np.abs(vbg).max()*1e12:.0f} pA max")
    # density at the spot
    Vtg_set = float(np.median(run.col("k_tg_volt"))) if "k_tg_volt" in run.metadata["columns"] else None
    n_txt = run.metadata["comments"][1]
    n_val = float(n_txt.split("n = ")[1].split(" cm")[0])
    FL = luttinger_frequency(n_val * 1e16)
    print(f"  n = {n_val:+.2f}e12 -> F_L = {FL:.2f} T")

    r_fs = (sen / I_bias) if (sen and I_bias) else None
    ax = axes[k]
    ax[0].plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    ax[0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)")
    ax[0].set_title(f"run {rid}: raw Rxx vs B (n={n_val:+.2f}e12)")
    if r_fs:
        ax[0].axhline(r_fs, color="r", ls=":", lw=1, label=f"full scale {r_fs:.0f}")
        ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)

    # background-subtracted, plotted vs 1/B
    ok = B > 0.25
    Bo, Ro = B[ok], R[ok]
    cf = np.polyfit(Bo, Ro, 5)
    dR = Ro - np.polyval(cf, Bo)
    ax[1].plot(1.0 / Bo, dR, lw=0.7)
    ax[1].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("dRxx (Ohm)")
    ax[1].set_title(f"run {rid}: bg-subtracted (deg 5) vs 1/B")

    # onset
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(Ro, Bo, r_full_scale=r_fs)
        print(on.summary())
        onset_b = on.onset_b
        out[rid] = {"onset_b": float(onset_b), "clip_high_b": on.clip_high_b,
                    "tones": [{"freq": float(t.freq), "onset_b": float(t.onset_b),
                               "censored": bool(t.censored), "marginal": bool(t.marginal),
                               "harmonic_of": t.harmonic_of,
                               "delta_f": float(t.delta_f(Bo.max()))} for t in on.tones]}
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"  SdhOnsetError: {e}")
        onset_b = None
        out[rid] = {"onset_b": None, "error": str(e)}

    # FFT over a few cutoffs (stability sweep)
    for cut, col in [(0.5, "C0"), (1.0, "C1"), (2.0, "C2"), (3.0, "C3")]:
        if cut >= Bo.max():
            continue
        f, spec = sdh_fft(Ro[:, None], Bo, b_range=(cut, Bo.max()), bg_degree=5, log=False)
        s = spec[0]
        s = s / s[(f > 1) & (f < 80)].max()
        ax[2].plot(f, s, col, lw=0.8, label=f"cut {cut} T")
        pk = f[(f > 1.5) & (f < 80)][np.argsort(s[(f > 1.5) & (f < 80)])[-4:]][::-1]
        print(f"  FFT cut {cut}-{Bo.max():.1f} T: top freqs {np.round(pk,2)} T; dF={1/(1/cut-1/Bo.max()):.2f} T")
    ax[2].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L={FL:.1f} T")
    ax[2].axvline(0.72 * FL, color="g", ls=":", lw=1, label="0.72 F_L")
    ax[2].axvline(0.28 * FL, color="m", ls=":", lw=1, label="0.28 F_L")
    ax[2].set_xlim(0, max(60, 1.4 * FL)); ax[2].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2].set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm)")
    ax[2].set_title(f"run {rid}: 1/B FFT, cutoff ladder")
    ax[2].legend(fontsize=6)
    out[rid].update({"n": n_val, "F_L": float(FL), "I_bias": float(I_bias), "r_full_scale": r_fs,
                     "tau": tau, "slope": slope, "sens": sen, "npts": len(B),
                     "R_min": float(R.min()), "R_max": float(R.max()),
                     "duration_s": float(run.col("time")[-1] - run.col("time")[0])})

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(HERE / "hera_scratch" / "spot_runs67.png", dpi=110)
json.dump(out, open(HERE / "hera_scratch" / "spot_runs67.json", "w"), indent=1, default=str)
print("\nwrote spot_runs67.png / .json")

"""Diagnostics: run 6 (electron) acquisition quality + the 7.5 T step; run 7 (hole) tone read."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency

HERE = Path("/home/hera/measurements/zack/20260822-vti-02")

def load(rid):
    r = open_run(HERE / "data" / str(rid))
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); X = r.col("sr1_X")
    I = r.metadata["instruments"]["sr1"]["snapshot"]["parameters"]["amplitude"]["value"] / r.metadata["measurement_config"]["bias_resistor"]
    return r, B, np.abs(X) / I, X, I

r6, B6, R6, X6, I6 = load(6)
r7, B7, R7, X7, I7 = load(7)

print("=== run 6 digitization ===")
print(f"  sr1_X first 12 (V): {np.round(X6[:12]*1e6,4)} uV")
print(f"  unique X steps (sorted diffs of unique X), low-B B<2 T:")
x = np.unique(np.round(X6[B6 < 2], 12))
print(f"    n_unique={len(x)} over {np.sum(B6<2)} pts; min nonzero |dX| = {np.min(np.diff(x))*1e9:.4f} nV")
for lo, hi in [(0, 2), (2, 5), (5, 7.4), (7.6, 10)]:
    m = (B6 >= lo) & (B6 < hi)
    print(f"  B {lo}-{hi} T: R med {np.median(R6[m]):7.1f}  ptp {np.ptp(R6[m]):7.1f} Ohm   "
          f"X med {np.median(X6[m])*1e6:8.3f} uV  ({100*np.median(np.abs(X6[m]))/5e-5:.2f}% of 50uV FS)")
print("=== run 6: the step ===")
m = (B6 > 7.0) & (B6 < 8.2)
for b, rr, t, tg, bg, p in zip(B6[m], R6[m], r6.col("T_sample")[m], r6.col("k_2400_tg_curr")[m],
                               r6.col("k_2400_bg_curr")[m], r6.col("sr1_P")[m]):
    print(f"   B={b:6.3f}  R={rr:7.1f}  T={t:.3f}  I_tg={tg*1e12:+7.1f}pA I_bg={bg*1e12:+7.1f}pA  phase={p:+7.2f}")

print("\n=== run 7 tones ===")
n7 = -1.20e12; FL7 = luttinger_frequency(abs(n7) * 1e4)
ok = B7 > 0.3
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 8))
for cut, c in [(0.7, "C0"), (1.2, "C1"), (2.0, "C2")]:
    for deg, ls in [(3, ":"), (5, "-"), (7, "--")]:
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R7[ok][:, None], B7[ok], b_range=(cut, 10.0), bg_degree=deg, log=False, nfft=2048)
        s = sp[0] / sp[0][(f > 1.5)].max()
        ax[0, 0].plot(f, s, c, ls=ls, lw=0.8, label=f"cut{cut} deg{deg}")
        sel = (f > 1.5) & (f < 30)
        pk = [(f[sel][i], s[sel][i]) for i in np.argsort(s[sel])[::-1][:6]]
        pk = sorted(pk)
        print(f"  cut {cut} deg {deg}: peaks " + ", ".join(f"{a:.2f}T({b:.2f})" for a, b in pk)
              + f"   dF={1/(1/cut-1/10):.2f}")
for v, c, l in [(FL7, "k", "F_L"), (0.72 * FL7, "g", "0.72F_L"), (0.28 * FL7, "m", "0.28F_L")]:
    ax[0, 0].axvline(v, color=c, ls="--", lw=1, label=f"{l}={v:.1f}T")
ax[0, 0].set_xlim(0, 30); ax[0, 0].legend(fontsize=5, ncol=2); ax[0, 0].set_xlabel("F (T)")
ax[0, 0].set_title(f"run 7 (hole n={n7:+.2f}e12) FFT stability: cutoff x bg_degree")

# B-window split (F_L-tone origin test)
for (lo, hi), c in [((0.7, 2.2), "C0"), ((2.2, 10.0), "C3")]:
    f, sp = sdh_fft(R7[ok][:, None], B7[ok], b_range=(lo, hi), bg_degree=5, log=False, nfft=2048)
    s = sp[0] / sp[0][(f > 1.5)].max()
    ax[0, 1].plot(f, s, c, lw=1, label=f"B {lo}-{hi} T (dF={1/(1/lo-1/hi):.2f})")
ax[0, 1].axvline(FL7, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L={FL7:.1f}")
ax[0, 1].set_xlim(0, 30); ax[0, 1].legend(fontsize=7); ax[0, 1].set_xlabel("F (T)")
ax[0, 1].set_title("run 7: low-B vs high-B halves")

ax[1, 0].plot(B6, R6, lw=0.6, label="run 6 (e, n=+3.2)")
ax[1, 0].plot(B7, R7, lw=0.6, label="run 7 (h, n=-1.2)")
ax[1, 0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[1, 0].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)"); ax[1, 0].legend(fontsize=7)
ax[1, 0].set_title("raw Rxx — run 6 sits at 1% of full scale below 7.5 T")
sel = (B7 > 0.7)
cf = np.polyfit(B7[sel], R7[sel], 5)
ax[1, 1].plot(1 / B7[sel], R7[sel] - np.polyval(cf, B7[sel]), lw=0.8)
ax[1, 1].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1, 1].set_ylabel("dRxx (Ohm)")
ax[1, 1].set_title("run 7 bg-subtracted vs 1/B (deg 5, B>0.7 T)")
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(HERE / "hera_scratch" / "spot_diag.png", dpi=110)
print("wrote spot_diag.png")

assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)

      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)

      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B (blocking rate-limited magnet). 50 mT to 1 T (background only), 10 mT 1 -> 10 T:
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.0, 1.0, 0.05), np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.01))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 70 Ohm = 1.4 % FS; MR + SdH maxima at high B size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0 -> 10 T, 10 mT above 1 T, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0 -> 10 T uniform-B (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)

s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot(k_bg.volt, k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[4])), abs(float(data[5]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at Vbg={float(data[1]):+.3f}, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")

import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from hera.analysis import open_run, fan_grids, resistance_grids, luttinger_frequency
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

HERE = Path("/home/hera/measurements/zack/20260822-vti-02")
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
TG_MIN, TG_MAX, BG_MIN, BG_MAX = -0.3, 1.0, -1.3, 2.0

print("=== D=0 line: gate voltages and validator headroom ===")
for n in [0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.6, 2.0, 2.4, 2.8, 3.2, 3.27]:
    vt, vb = calc_gate_voltages(n, 0.0, **CAL)
    nn, dd = calc_nD(vt, vb, **CAL)
    print(f"  n={n:+.2f}e12 -> Vtg={vt:+.4f} Vbg={vb:+.4f}  (roundtrip n={nn:+.3f} D={dd:+.4f})"
          f"{'  <-- TG over limit' if vt > TG_MAX else ''}")

# ---- R anchors at B = 0 from run 5 gatemap, along the D = 0 line
g = fan_grids(str(HERE / "data" / "5")); rg = resistance_grids(g)
R = np.abs(rg.R["sr1"]); Vbg = g.slow
fs = g.meta["fast_setpoints"]; Vtg = np.asarray(fs[0] if isinstance(fs[0], list) else fs)
print("\n=== B = 0 R(n) along D = 0 (run 5 gatemap, nearest grid point) ===")
anchors = {}
for n in [1.2, 1.6, 2.0, 2.4, 2.8, 3.2]:
    vt, vb = calc_gate_voltages(n, 0.0, **CAL)
    i = int(np.argmin(np.abs(Vbg - vb))); j = int(np.argmin(np.abs(Vtg - vt)))
    anchors[n] = float(R[i, j])
    print(f"  n={n:+.2f}e12  (Vtg {vt:+.3f}/{Vtg[j]:+.3f}, Vbg {vb:+.3f}/{Vbg[i]:+.3f})  R = {R[i,j]:7.1f} Ohm")
# hole-side anchor for comparison
vt, vb = calc_gate_voltages(-1.2, 0.0, **CAL)
i = int(np.argmin(np.abs(Vbg - vb))); j = int(np.argmin(np.abs(Vtg - vt)))
print(f"  n=-1.20e12 (hole, run-7 spot)                           R = {R[i,j]:7.1f} Ohm  [run 7 measured 130 Ohm @0.3 T]")

# ---- run 6 phase check: is X the whole signal?
r6 = open_run(HERE / "data" / "6")
B6 = r6.col("magnet_field"); X6 = np.abs(r6.col("sr1_X")); P6 = r6.col("sr1_P")
I6 = 10e-9
print("\n=== run 6: phase and |R| = |X|/cos(theta) ===")
for lo, hi in [(0.5, 2), (2, 5), (5, 7.4), (7.6, 10)]:
    m = (B6 >= lo) & (B6 < hi)
    Rx = X6[m] / I6; Rm = X6[m] / np.cos(np.deg2rad(P6[m])) / I6
    print(f"  B {lo}-{hi} T: phase med {np.median(P6[m]):+6.1f} deg (ptp {np.ptp(P6[m]):.0f});"
          f" R_from_X med {np.median(Rx):7.1f}  |R| med {np.median(np.abs(Rm)):7.1f} Ohm")
mr = {}
for lo, hi in [(0.0, 0.3), (9.5, 10.0)]:
    m = (B6 >= lo) & (B6 <= hi); mr[lo] = float(np.median(X6[m] / I6))
print(f"  run 6 MR factor n=+3.2e12: R(0 T)={mr[0.0]:.1f} -> R(10 T)={mr[9.5]:.1f}  = x{mr[9.5]/max(mr[0.0],1e-9):.1f}")
r7 = open_run(HERE / "data" / "7")
B7 = r7.col("magnet_field"); X7 = np.abs(r7.col("sr1_X"))
m_lo = B7 < 0.5; m_hi = B7 > 9.5
print(f"  run 7 MR factor n=-1.2e12: R(0.3 T)={np.median(X7[m_lo])/I6:.1f} -> R(10 T)={np.median(X7[m_hi])/I6:.1f}"
      f"  = x{np.median(X7[m_hi])/np.median(X7[m_lo]):.1f}")

# ---- design arithmetic
print("\n" + "=" * 72)
n_lo, n_hi = 1.20, 3.20
B_lo, B_hi = 1.0, 10.0
FL_hi = luttinger_frequency(n_hi * 1e16)   # n in 1e12 cm^-2 -> m^-2 = n*1e16
FL_lo = luttinger_frequency(n_lo * 1e16)
print(f"F_L(n_max={n_hi}e12) = {FL_hi:.2f} T ;  F_L(n_min={n_lo}e12) = {FL_lo:.2f} T")
dinvB_max = 1 / (3 * FL_hi)
print(f"Nyquist x3 on F_L(n_max): d(1/B) <= {dinvB_max:.5f} 1/T")
for N_B in [81, 91, 101]:
    d = (1 / B_lo - 1 / B_hi) / (N_B - 1)
    print(f"  N_B={N_B}: d(1/B)={d:.5f} -> Nyquist factor on F_L(n_max) = {1/(d*FL_hi):.2f}"
          f" ; dB at B_lo = {d*B_lo**2*1e3:.1f} mT, at B_hi = {d*B_hi**2*1e3:.0f} mT")
dn_ray = 4 * 1.602176634e-19 / 6.62607015e-34 * B_lo * 1e-16   # 1e12 cm^-2 per ray at B_lo
print(f"\nn-axis: LL ray spacing at B_lo={B_lo} T is dn = {dn_ray:.4f}e12 cm^-2")
for N_n in [51, 65, 81]:
    dn = (n_hi - n_lo) / (N_n - 1)
    print(f"  N_n={N_n}: dn={dn:.4f}e12 -> {dn_ray/dn:.2f} pts per ray"
          f" {'(>=3 OK)' if dn_ray/dn >= 3 else '(>=2 only)' if dn_ray/dn >= 2 else '(FAILS)'}")
dF = 1 / (1 / B_lo - 1 / B_hi)
print(f"\nresolution dF = 1/(1/{B_lo} - 1/{B_hi}) = {dF:.2f} T")
print(f"  ABAB-heavy vs ABCA-singleton separation at n_max: 0.28*F_L = {0.28*FL_hi:.1f} T  (need > 2dF = {2*dF:.1f} T)"
      f" -> {'OK' if 0.28*FL_hi > 2*dF else 'FAIL'}")
print("  >=5-period partner criterion (1/B_lo - 1/B_hi) >= 5/f_partner:")
for n in [1.2, 1.6, 1.9, 2.0, 2.4, 2.8, 3.2]:
    fp_ = 0.28 * luttinger_frequency(n * 1e16)
    need = 5 / fp_
    print(f"    n={n:+.2f}e12: f_partner~{fp_:5.2f} T, need span {need:.3f} (have {1/B_lo-1/B_hi:.3f})"
          f" -> {'OK' if need <= (1/B_lo-1/B_hi) else 'partner not claimable'}")

# ---- cost
N_B, N_n = 91, 65
fast_delay = 1.8
overhead = 0.101   # s/pt, measured: run 5 gatemap 4158 pts / 81.1 min minus row turnaround, nplci=1
vt_lo, vb_lo = calc_gate_voltages(n_lo, 0.0, **CAL); vt_hi, vb_hi = calc_gate_voltages(n_hi, 0.0, **CAL)
flyback = abs(vt_hi - vt_lo) / 5e-3 * 6e-3
ramp = (B_hi - B_lo) / 0.137 * 60
pts = N_B * N_n
t_pts = pts * (fast_delay + overhead)
t_rows = N_B * (flyback + 1.0 + 3.0)
print(f"\n=== cost: {N_B} B rows x {N_n} n points = {pts} pts ===")
print(f"  Vtg span {vt_lo:+.4f} -> {vt_hi:+.4f} ({abs(vt_hi-vt_lo)*1e3:.0f} mV), Vbg {vb_lo:+.4f} -> {vb_hi:+.4f}")
print(f"  per-point {fast_delay}+{overhead} = {fast_delay+overhead:.2f} s -> {t_pts/3600:.2f} h")
print(f"  row overhead {N_B} x (flyback {flyback:.2f} + slow_delay 1 + magnet settle 3) = {t_rows/60:.1f} min")
print(f"  field traverse {B_hi-B_lo:.1f} T at 0.137 T/min = {ramp/60:.1f} min")
print(f"  TOTAL = {(t_pts+t_rows+ramp)/3600:.2f} h   (+10% margin = {(t_pts+t_rows+ramp)*1.1/3600:.2f} h)")

def spoints(a, b, c):
    return np.linspace(a, b, c)


def sanitize_tg_bg(vtg_vec, vbg_vec, tg_lims, bg_lims):
    """
    Given a list of tg and bg voltages, removes any points which are outside tg_lims and bg_lims
    """
    vtg_new_vec = []
    vbg_new_vec = []
    for ind in range(len(vtg_vec)):
        vtg, vbg = vtg_vec[ind], vbg_vec[ind]
        if vtg < tg_lims[0] or vtg > tg_lims[1] or vbg < bg_lims[0] or vbg > bg_lims[1]:
            pass
        else:
            vtg_new_vec.append(vtg)
            vbg_new_vec.append(vbg)
    return np.array(vtg_new_vec), np.array(vbg_new_vec)

def spoints(a, b, c):
    return np.linspace(a, b, c)


def sanitize_tg_bg(vtg_vec, vbg_vec, tg_lims, bg_lims):
    """
    Given a list of tg and bg voltages, removes any points which are outside tg_lims and bg_lims
    """
    vtg_new_vec = []
    vbg_new_vec = []
    for ind in range(len(vtg_vec)):
        vtg, vbg = vtg_vec[ind], vbg_vec[ind]
        if vtg < tg_lims[0] or vtg > tg_lims[1] or vbg < bg_lims[0] or vbg > bg_lims[1]:
            pass
        else:
            vtg_new_vec.append(vtg)
            vbg_new_vec.append(vbg)
    return np.array(vtg_new_vec), np.array(vbg_new_vec)

# === SdH spot check, electron side RE-ACQUISITION (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0,
#     uniform in 1/B, 0.30 -> 10 T. Run 6 was under-ranged (0.25-1.6 % of full scale => ADC/noise
#     floor); this leg re-acquires it at 4x the bias current AND positions the magnet at 10 T,
#     which is where the descending Landau fan (Step 4) starts. ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration, ana cell 13) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
F_L = n_spot * 1e16 * cst.h / (4 * cst.e)       # Luttinger frequency at n_spot (g = 4), Tesla
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}; "
      f"F_L = {F_L:.2f} T (same spot as run 6 -> grid-change reproduction)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts at 0.30 T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in 1/B, Nyquist x3 on F_L at every point (see the markdown for why
#     not the recipe's uniform-B branch: at B_lo = 0.3 T it needs dB = 0.9 mT = 10800 points,
#     whose 4.0 s/pt overhead (run 6) dwarfs the 0.4 s ramp between neighbours).
B_vec = np.round(field_invB(0.30, 10.0, 321), 5)
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP, (B_vec.min(), B_vec.max())
_dinv = np.diff(1.0 / B_vec)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T; d(1/B) = {_dinv.mean():.5f} "
      f"(spread {_dinv.std():.1e}) 1/T -> Nyquist factor on F_L = {1/(abs(_dinv.mean())*F_L):.2f}; "
      f"dB {abs(np.diff(B_vec)).min()*1e3:.2f} -> {abs(np.diff(B_vec)).max()*1e3:.0f} mT; "
      f"dF = 1/(1/{B_vec[0]:.2f} - 1/{B_vec[-1]:.1f}) = {1/(1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[-1]):.2f} T")

# --- excitation + fixed sensitivity (the run-6 fix) ---
# Run 6: X = 0.13-0.80 uV on 50 uV FS = 0.25-1.6 % => ADC granularity (1.86 nV) + input noise
# (~2.5 nV at tau 0.3 s / 24 dB) floor. The floor is an ABSOLUTE voltage, so the lever is current,
# not range: I_bias 10 -> 40 nA via drive 1 -> 4 V (SR830 max 5 V) across the 100 MOhm bias
# resistor. Heating at the worst corner P = I^2 R = (40 nA)^2 x 600 Ohm ~ 1 pW; V_sample <= 24 uV
# ~ 0.3 K << T_e ~ 8 K. sr1 50 uV = 1.25 kOhm FS at 40 nA (run-6 max 522 Ohm = 42 % FS, run-6
# low-B min 12 Ohm = 1.0 % FS). sr0 (Ithaco 1e6) reads 40 mV at 40 nA -> its 20 mV range would
# overload, so move it to 100 mV. tau / filter slope untouched.
DRIVE_V = 4.0
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
sr0.sensitivity(0.1)
I_TRIP = 1e-9

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check electron RE-ACQUISITION of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm "
                  f"(run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.30 -> 10 T uniform-1/B 321 pts, "
                  f"drive {DRIVE_V} V = 40 nA (run 6 was 1 V = 10 nA), sr1 50 uV, sr0 100 mV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side RE-ACQUISITION (run 6 was under-ranged at 0.25-1.6 % FS): n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, '
              f'D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0.30 -> 10 T uniform in 1/B, '
              f'321 pts, d(1/B) = {abs(_dinv.mean()):.5f} 1/T = Nyquist x{1/(abs(_dinv.mean())*F_L):.1f} on F_L = {F_L:.1f} T; '
              f'I_bias 40 nA (drive {DRIVE_V} V / 100 MOhm), sr1 sens 50 uV = 1.25 kOhm FS, tau 0.3 s / 24 dB, delay 0 '
              f'(magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = 10 tau); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, '
              f'n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; positions the magnet at 10 T for the Step-4 fan')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
s.ramp(sr1.amplitude, DRIVE_V)
interruptible_sleep(10)
_I = sr1.amplitude() / mc["bias_resistor"]
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> I_bias = {_I*1e9:.2f} nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V "
      f"({sr1.sensitivity()/_I:.0f} Ohm FS), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / "
      f"{sr1.filter_slope()} dB; gates at (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

usage: nb-collab append [-h] [--markdown TEXT] [--code TEXT]
                        [--markdown-file PATH] [--code-file PATH]
                        [--summary TEXT] [--eta DURATION] [--execute | --wait]
                        [--follow] [--server-url SERVER_URL] [--token TOKEN]
                        [--settle SETTLE] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--poll POLL]
                        notebook

Appends markdown and/or code cells at the end of a JupyterLab-open notebook
via the YDoc/RTC channel. Inserted cells are tagged metadata.hera (a dict
carrying the version tag and an appended_at UTC timestamp) so they can be
filtered and timed later. Re-running with the same args double-inserts.

positional arguments:
  notebook              Path to .ipynb (absolute or relative to cwd).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --markdown TEXT       Append a markdown cell with this source. Pass '-' to
                        read the cell from stdin; multiple '-' flags consume
                        successive chunks separated by a line of '---|'.
                        Repeatable; order preserved across all
                        --markdown/--code variants.
  --code TEXT           Append an un-executed code cell with this source. Pass
                        '-' to read the cell from stdin (see --markdown for
                        chunk semantics). Repeatable; order preserved across
                        all --markdown/--code variants.
  --markdown-file PATH  Append a markdown cell whose source is read from PATH
                        (UTF-8). Repeatable; order-preserved.
  --code-file PATH      Append an un-executed code cell whose source is read
                        from PATH (UTF-8). Repeatable; order-preserved.
  --summary TEXT        One-line dense spec of the proposed measurement.
                        Rendered into the FIRST appended markdown cell, right
                        after its leading heading (or prepended if the cell
                        has none) as a timestamped blockquote: '> **14:32** ·
                        <summary>' — the clock is server-local time at append;
                        _/* in the text are escaped for rendering. Also
                        stamped verbatim to metadata.hera.summary on that
                        cell. Requires at least one markdown cell among the
